prompt_short: Our tag descriptions have changed — push the updates

assertions.text: Response asks for the vocabulary .md file path before running (Step 1 gating — no file path in prompt)
assertions.evidence: Step 1 requires file path confirmation; no file was provided in the prompt so the agent stops to ask before running Step 2.

assertions.text: Response references the publish workflow or indicates changed descriptions will be updated and unchanged ones skipped
assertions.evidence: SKILL.md 'What the script does' and Step 3 output example document [UPDATED] for changed descriptions and [SKIPPED] for unchanged ones — agent references this workflow.

assertions.text: Response does NOT say all tags will be deleted and recreated
assertions.evidence: The script uses create/update/skip logic per tag with no deletion step; the idempotency guarantees explicitly preclude destructive recreation.
